title: Deploy open AI workloads on Azure with Red Hat and AKS
description:
Discover how Red Hat brings open choice to Azure AI development—from OS to inference. Explore how Red Hat AI Inference delivers a consistent, portable open-source stack on AKS. See how MCP and Ansible Lightspeed with Copilot connect AI agents to Azure infrastructure. Whether optimizing LLM throughput or building agents, learn to create flexible AI solutions with Red Hat and Azure.

Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.
